jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production hand-painted MATTE medieval 2D game animation sheet matching reference painting, textured warm cel shading, NO gloss/glow. Pure flat #FF00FF MAGENTA background, no magenta clothing. NO white gridlines/borders, numbers, text, scenery or floor shadows. Right-facing full figure with ALL weapons and detached props entirely inside its OWN square cell, generous 25px empty gutters, nothing crossing cells. Exactly same anatomical body/head size across poses, NEVER enlarge bent or fallen figures. Cells will export512x512, feet baseliney487. HASAN AGA heavy Ottoman armored boss: broad stocky older man with GREY BEARD, thick LAMELLAR steel plate armor over dark rust kaftan, pointed STEEL HELMET with CHAINMAIL neck aventail, ROUND STEEL SHIELD in LEFT hand, short iron MACE in RIGHT hand. Very heavy armored silhouette. No sword, no fabric white hat. EXACT 4 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS of equal SQUARE cells, row-major. FIRST 6 cells actual animation. Cell 7 neutral UPRIGHT STANDING scale-calibration with same costume/weapons, NOT used in clip. All remaining cells EMPTY MAGENTA. Six breathing phases: heavy wide stance, round shield FORWARD covering chest, mace low by right hip; inhale chest rises/exhale lowers, armor straps settle, slow head motion. Loop closes naturally.
